description: A desert adventure exploring resilience and desert wildlife in Grade 4.
content: Far out in the golden sands of the Thar Desert lived a quick and curious desert fox named Fennec. One sunny morning, Fennec noticed a trail of green leaves blown by the wind. Following the trail across the dunes, Fennec discovered a hidden oasis with sweet water and date palms, welcoming all the desert animals to drink and rest.
title: The Desert Fox and the Hidden Oasis
The Courageous Dolphin of Chilika Lake
description: A heartwarming tale of bravery and friendship in Grade 3.
content: Deep in the sunlit waters of Chilika Lake lived Zoya and a friendly dolphin named Splash. Together they explored coral gardens and protected the little sea creatures.
